sentences.text: Shri Rajendra Singh Yadav and Shri Brijesh Tyagi, learned cou  for the appellants.
Shri C.P.Singh, learned Panel Lawyer for the respondent/State Sub-Inspector Ankit Upadhyay, police Station, Kolaras Distt. Shivpuri, present in person before the Court in compliance of earlier order.

Heard on IA.Nos.2226/2023 & 3680/2023, third application and second application u/Sec. 389 of Cr.P.C. for suspension of sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of appellants No.2 and 1, namely Sukhdev Singh and Malkeet Singh respectively.

In brief prosecution case is that complainant Kuldeep Kaur filed a written complaint in police Station Badarwas that her land survey No.660 area 0.66 hectare & survey No.762 area 0.85 situated at village Keldhar Patwari Halka No.62 Tahsil Kolaras Distt. Shivpuri, of which she is the owner and possession holder, has been illegally sold by Ramratan to Raghuveer Singh in collusion with Registrar and Patwari.
When she contacted Ramratan, he abused and threatened her.
Allegation against the appellants is that they are the witnesses of the sale- deed and they identified Ramratan.
On her report, offence was registered.
Appellants and co-accused were arrested.
After completion of investigation, charge-sheet was submitted.

After trial, appellants have been convicted under Sections 420/120-B, 467/120-B and 468/120-B of IPC and sentenced to undergo 5 years RI with fine of Rs.500/-, 7 years RI with fine of Rs.1,000/- and 5 years RI with fine of Rs.500/- respectively.

It is submitted by learned counsel for the appellants that appellants are only the witnesses of the aforesaid sale-deed and co-accused Ramratan along with the land of his brother sold the property of Kuldeep Kaur.
During trial they were on bail, but they did not misuse the liberty so granted.
After judgment of the trial Court dated 15.11.2022, they are in custody.
Final hearing of the appeal will take time and they have a good case on merit.
Therefore, prayer for suspension of sentence has been made.
Learned counsel for the State opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.

sentences.text:
Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting upon merits of the case, IA.Nos.2226/2023 & 3680/2023 are allowed and it is directed that jail sentence of appellants Sukhdev Singh and Malkeet Singh will remain under suspension subject to verification that amount of fine has been deposited, on appellants' furnishing bail bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) each with one solvent surety each of the like amount to the satisfaction of concerned Trial Court for their appearance before the Principal Registrar of this Court on 10th July,
2023 and on such further dates as may be fixed by the office in this regard till disposal of the appeal.
Certified copy as per rules.

(DEEPAK KUMAR AGARWAL) JUDGE ms/-
